portInfo.description: Seehafen Stralsund GmbH presents a multimodal universal port in north-east Germany (bulk/general cargo, rail-connected Frankenhafen development) at about 54°18′N 13°06′E. Cruise-specific berth diagrams were not on the English home page. The 2026 Regulations and Charges PDF nonetheless tariffs ocean cruise vessels and other passenger/cruise categories, which is evidence that cruise calls are handled under port rules. City tourism markets UNESCO World Heritage brick Gothic, museums including OZEANEUM/Meeresmuseum, and a short urban beach. Do not invent a Stadthafen vs Frankenhafen assignment without a primary cruise berthing sheet.

thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Ask the ship which Stralsund quay before timing a museum ticket.
